description: Find the most recent common ancestor (MRCA) of 2-10 taxa in the synthetic Tree of Life, by ott_id (from match_names). Returns the common-ancestor taxon (ott_id, name, rank). Keyless.

ott_ids.description: OTT taxon ids to find the common ancestor of, e.g. [770315,417950]. 2-10 ids, from match_names.
